domain.origin: Only the exact successful admitProtectedBrowser snapshot registered in this same Core instance; ordinary, copied, foreign, consumed or closed origins reject.
domain.interpretation: Complete original base 0.5.0 or native 0.6.0 payload/IR admission; catalog is a projection of that complete origin.

rules.tuple: Request tuple must equal the actual immutable origin snapshot tuple (base 0.5.0 VersionTuple or 0.6.0 CandidateVersionTuple06). Unknown, cross-generation and mixed tuples reject.
rules.authority: Fresh independent current callback and immutable origin signature-policy check for admission, every read and each lifecycle boundary including transport. Unlock observation never grants read authority.
rules.capture_id: Ephemeral same-operation retained-origin identity, not a file-descriptor or new physical capture attestation.
rules.ingress: Request/policy and settled Host observations are primitive JSON text, strict duplicate-key/scalar parsing and generated validators. Opaque tokens are same-instance WeakMap authority. Trusted callback returns retain JavaScript await semantics.
rules.projection: Original registry ordered closure/whole semantics reused. Set selections union mandatory closures of original single-judgment base IR in original global node order. Selection-set handles are separately bound to operation/origin/Host; no recursive target discovery.
rules.budget: Entire final envelope including verification, binding, disclosure and handles is measured by exact canonical JSON bytes before Host handoff.
rules.delivery: Independent two current Host observations and final transport observation cover full projection and deferred target scopes; denial/epoch/expiry rules apply. Handles register only after confirmed deliver and current read return.
rules.lifecycle: Origin reserved before authority await. Transport token reserved before callbacks, consumed and outcome_unknown recorded before one synchronous side effect. Dispose cancels pending boundaries, clears private retained references, revokes registered handles and prevents late delivery. Caller-owned input/snapshot and previously disclosed bytes cannot be erased.
rules.truth: Integrity fields record original browser admission checksums/signature and A/C/E; retained projection does not claim AEAD/password authentication, new digest/domain/signature validation or physical IO. Read contract is independently kdna.protected-browser-read/0.1.0-candidate with ordinary projected content fields plus explicit browser verification.
